text: Good afternoon, hello, am I speaking with Mr Ramesh Chandra Srivastava, retired teacher from Gomti Nagar, Lucknow?

context: caller: Am I speaking with Mr Srivastava?
elder: Yes, who is this?
text: Sir, this is Inspector Vikram Rathore from the Central Bureau of Investigation, Mumbai unit, my badge number is CBI 4471.

text: No no, sir, this is a confidential national security matter, you cannot discuss it with your son or anybody in the family.

text: Do not open the door and do not tell anyone who is calling, if you leave the call it will be treated as escaping from investigation.

text: Ma'am, the, uh, the parcel contains five fake passports, three credit cards and 140 grams of MDMA, it is booked with your Aadhaar number.
